decisions.statement: A caller naming no sink is said to this process's own output.
A caller naming a sink has the output this run says back to its own reader.
Nothing reaches a terminal where a sink is named.
The ssh run is asked to be quiet where a sink is named.
The ssh run streams where the caller names no sink.
The ref is pinned to a single commit per repository before anything is built.
Both halves of a build are handed that commit rather than the ref.
A commit no origin ref reaches is refused rather than compiled.
The App Store Connect token is minted afresh for every read.
A build floor that will not read leaves the run on the durable mac counter.
A build floor that will not read ends a run that waits on processing.
An upload skipped still has Apple validate the exported build.
An upload skipped spends no build number.
The fingerprint is taken from the tree the cut was made at.
Nothing recomputes that fingerprint afterwards.
A filing that fails is tried four times.
An upload whose fingerprint will not file ends the run non-zero.
That run says the call filing the fingerprint verbatim.
An upload that succeeded is never made again over a fingerprint left unfiled.
The macbook run is named before its output is judged, since the upload lands first.
What the fingerprint recorder names is kept rather than dropped at the call.

definition: the run taking one iOS app from a pinned commit to a TestFlight build
